project: Project 3 - rolling out-of-sample portfolio construction on French 10 industries
status: historical A4 technical acceptance 2026-10-06; C10 teaching/interface limited-scope acceptance 2026-10-14; historical results reused

data.unit: decimal simple return per calendar month

primary.mean_estimator: training-window sample mean of industry minus RF (max_sharpe only)
primary.cost_model: linear haircut based on normalized weight turnover proxy, not exact self-financing traded notional

fallback: equal_weight; every fallback is logged with month and reason

bootstrap.statistic: mean monthly net return difference, and paired annualized net Sharpe difference, versus equal_weight

selection_rule: primary specification above is fixed before viewing any out-of-sample result; sensitivity rows are reported in full and are not used to choose a winner
pre_registration_evidence: author declaration and local revision log; no external preregistration timestamp; retrospective historical study
